# Milestones

::: callout-important
Each milestone submission will be graded for completion and will be penalized for late submissions. This is to ensure that you make regular progress on your project.
:::

1. Identify data (one or more datasets) and formulate 2-3 questions you want to answer (September 30)
2. Complete EDA and have a sense whether your questions are answerable from the data you are using (October 14)
3. Submit a draft narrative of what you think the answers to your questions are based on your preliminary analyses (October 28)
4. Describe the analyses you are doing, and provide 1-2 visualizations to indicate that the proposed approach is reasonable (November 11)
5. Submit your analysis plan for answering your questions. This will be in the appendix of your final submission (November 25)

We will publish expectations and a rubric for each milestone shortly.
